children: *CSTS Has Operating Subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Mainland China, Including Travel Agency Connexus Travel HK
*CSTS Enterprises Seeks Nasdaq Capital Market Listing Under Symbol CSTS
CSTS Enterprises filed for an initial public offering.
The travel company, which primarily operates in China and Hong Kong, blends travel agency with business-to-business-to-consumer services.

Its Connexus Travel platform is one of the long-standing licensed travel agencies in Hong Kong. It offers comprehensive technology platforms and services covering business travel, meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions, as well as other services.

CSTS was a sales agent for the FIFA Hospitality Program for the World Cup in greater China. After the World Cup, the company entered a deal to get exclusive rights relating to the promotion and sale of UEFA Euro 2028 hospitality packages in the greater China area.
CSTS's revenue in the quarter ended Aug. 31, 2026, was $13.6 million, with a loss of $4.4 million.
The company plans to trade shares on Nasdaq under the ticker CSTS.
